title: In a Sunburned Country
description: Bill Bryson travels through Australia, reveling in its vast deserts, hospitable locals, and abundance of venomous wildlife. His witty observations illuminate Australian colonial history and indigenous heritage.

title: The Great Railway Bazaar
description: Paul Theroux's classic travelogue recounting a four-month overland rail journey from London across Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia on the Trans-Siberian Railway. It captures the rhythm and eccentricities of long-distance rail travel.

title: Dark Star Safari
description: An unvarnished travelogue detailing an overland trek the length of the African continent by bus, train, and dugout canoe. Theroux reflects on post-colonial politics, international aid dependencies, and local resilience.

title: Lands of Lost Borders
description: Kate Harris recounts a year-long bicycle expedition tracing the ancient Silk Road through mountains and restricted frontiers. The memoir reflects on explorer history, geopolitics, and wilderness preservation.

title: In Cold Blood
description: Truman Capote's pioneering non-fiction novel reconstructing the brutal 1959 Clutter family murders in Holcomb, Kansas. Through meticulous investigative reporting, Capote explores criminal psychology and rural community grief.

title: The Devil in the White City
description: Erik Larson weaves the story of Daniel Burnham, architect of the 1893 Chicago World's Fair, with the story of serial killer H. H. Holmes. The narrative juxtaposes architectural wonder against sinister predatory deception.

title: I'll Be Gone in the Dark
description: Journalist Michelle McNamara's compelling journalistic pursuit of the unidentified Golden State Killer who terrorized California for a decade. The investigation ultimately contributed to the perpetrator's capture through forensic genealogy.

title: Helter Skelter
description: The definitive courtroom account of the 1969 Tate-LaBianca murders written by prosecuting attorney Vincent Bugliosi. It chronicles the investigation, cult psychology, and trial of Charles Manson and his followers.

title: Mindhunter
description: Former FBI special agent John Douglas recounts the founding of the FBI's behavioral profiling unit and interviews with notorious serial offenders. The memoir explains criminal signature analysis and psychological investigative techniques.

title: Columbine
description: A comprehensive ten-year investigation dispelling persistent media myths regarding the 1999 high school massacre. Cullen meticulously examines the psychological profiles of the perpetrators and the community's recovery.

title: Midnight in the Garden of Good and Evil
description: A mesmerizing atmospheric portrait of Savannah, Georgia, centered around the high-profile murder trial of antique dealer Jim Williams. Berendt captures the eccentric personalities, voodoo rituals, and Southern gothic ambiance.

title: One Piece, Vol. 1: Romance Dawn
description: The opening volume of Eiichiro Oda's pirate adventure following Monkey D. Luffy, a spirited boy whose body gained rubber properties from eating a Devil Fruit. Luffy sets out across the East Blue to gather a loyal crew and search for the mythical One Piece treasure.

title: One Piece, Vol. 2: Buggy the Clown
description: Luffy and swordsman Roronoa Zoro arrive in an occupied port town where they encounter the cunning thief Nami and battle the theatrical Buggy the Clown. High-seas humor and dynamic battle choreography highlight this early adventure arc.

title: One Piece, Vol. 3: Don't Get Fooled Again
description: The Straw Hat Pirates continue their voyage to Syrup Village, crossing paths with the habitual storyteller Usopp. The crew uncovers a sinister assassination conspiracy orchestrated by Captain Kuro against wealthy heiress Kaya.

title: Naruto, Vol. 1: Uzumaki Naruto
description: The inaugural chapter of Masashi Kishimoto's ninja saga introducing orphan Naruto Uzumaki, shunned by the Hidden Leaf Village for the Nine-Tails beast sealed inside him. Naruto perseveres to master the Shadow Clone technique and earn his headband.

title: Naruto, Vol. 2: The Worst Client
description: Assigned to Team 7 under mentor Kakashi Hatake, Naruto, Sasuke Uchiha, and Sakura Haruno undertake a seemingly basic bodyguard mission to the Land of Waves. The assignment rapidly escalates into lethal conflict against rogue assassins.

title: Naruto, Vol. 3: Bridge of Courage
description: Team 7 confronts demonic mist shinobi Zabuza Momochi and his deadly apprentice Haku in a climactic struggle on the Great Naruto Bridge. Themes of sacrifice, shinobi morality, and inner resolve come to the forefront.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba, Vol. 1: Cruelty
description: In Taisho-era Japan, kindhearted Tanjiro Kamado discovers his family slaughtered by demons, leaving his sister Nezuko cursed to transform into one. Tanjiro embarks on rigorous swordsmanship training to become a demon slayer and seek a cure.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba, Vol. 2: It Was You
description: Tanjiro undergoes the grueling Final Selection trial on Mount Fujikasane, confronting a monstrous morphed demon. Equipped with his Nichirin blade, he takes on his first official assignment in Asakusa, where he catches the scent of Muzan Kibutsuji.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba, Vol. 3: Believe in Yourself
description: Tanjiro and Nezuko join forces with doctor demon Tamayo and her assistant Yushiro to fend off assassins armed with deadly Temari balls and arrow vectors. The volume introduces fellow slayers Zenitsu Agatsuma and Inosuke Hashibira.

title: Attack on Titan 1
description: Humanity hides behind concentric defensive walls to protect against man-eating humanoid Titans. When a Colossal Titan breaches Wall Maria, young Eren Yeager witnesses his mother's death and vows to exterminate every Titan on earth.

title: Attack on Titan 2
description: Eren, Mikasa Ackerman, and Armin Arlert graduate from the 104th Training Corps just as the Colossal Titan reappears at the Trost District gate. As chaotic urban combat erupts, a shocking Titan transformation shifts the tide of battle.

title: Attack on Titan 3
description: The military establishment conducts a tense tribunal to decide whether Eren should be executed or placed under the custody of Captain Levi's Special Operations Squad. The Recon Corps plans a risky expedition outside the perimeter.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen, Vol. 1: Ryomen Sukuna
description: High school athlete Yuji Itadori swallows a cursed talisman—a severed rotting finger of King of Curses Ryomen Sukuna—to protect his peers. Sparing him from immediate execution, sorcerer Satoru Gojo enrolls Yuji at Tokyo Jujutsu High.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen, Vol. 2: Fearsome Womb
description: First-year students Yuji, Megumi Fushiguro, and Nobara Kugisaki are dispatched on an urgent reconnaissance mission to a juvenile detention center overtaken by a special grade cursed womb, culminating in Sukuna taking physical control.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen, Vol. 3: Young Fish and Reverse Punishment
description: While Megumi and Nobara train with upperclassmen for the upcoming Kyoto Goodwill Event, Yuji partners with grade-1 sorcerer Kento Nanami to investigate transfigured human corpses in Kanagawa tied to the curse Mahito.

title: The Infinity Gauntlet
authors: Jim Starlin; George Pérez; Ron Lim
description: The definitive cosmic crossover event where the Mad Titan Thanos assembles all six Infinity Gems to woo Mistress Death by snapping half of universal life from existence. Earth's surviving heroes join Adam Warlock in a cosmic resistance.

title: Civil War
description: A catastrophic tragedy in Stamford triggers the Superhuman Registration Act, fracturing the superhero community down ideological lines. Iron Man leads pro-registration federal forces while Captain America organizes an underground rebellion.

title: Spider-Man: Blue
description: A poignant, nostalgic reflection by Peter Parker on Valentine's Day recounting his early days as Spider-Man and falling in love with Gwen Stacy. Tim Sale's expressive watercolor style captures Silver Age superhero melodrama.

title: Marvels
description: Seen through the street-level camera lens of photojournalist Phil Sheldon, this painted masterpiece chronicles the dawn of the Marvel Universe from 1939 through 1973. Alex Ross's photorealistic art brings mythological gravity to heroes.

title: Ms. Marvel, Vol. 1: No Normal
description: Kamala Khan, a Pakistani-American Muslim teenager living in Jersey City, suddenly manifests shape-shifting Inhuman powers after encountering Terrigen Mist. Balancing high school expectations with heroic responsibility, she adopts the Ms. Marvel mantle.

title: Hawkeye, Vol. 1: My Life as a Weapon
description: An inventive, indie-inflected superhero run following Clint Barton during his downtime in Brooklyn alongside protegee Kate Bishop. Featuring crisp minimalist art and dry wit, Clint takes on Russian tracksuit mobsters to defend his apartment building.

title: Ultimate Spider-Man, Vol. 1: Power and Responsibility
description: A ground-up modern reboot of Peter Parker's origin story tailored for twenty-first century readers. Bendis focuses deeply on high school angst, Aunt May and Uncle Ben's warmth, and Peter's transformation following a genetically altered spider bite.

title: Daredevil: Born Again
description: When Matt Murdock's ex-girlfriend Karen Page trades his secret identity for heroin, Wilson Fisk systematically dismantles Matt's legal career, home, and sanity. A raw, operatic narrative of spiritual ruin and redemptive resurrection.

title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
description: In a nightmarish alternate 2013 where Sentinel robots have enslaved mutants and humans in concentration camps, Kate Pryde transfers her consciousness back to 1980 to prevent the political assassination that triggered the dystopia.

title: Black Panther: A Nation Under Our Feet, Book 1
description: Acclaimed author Ta-Nehisi Coates pens a cerebral political drama examining Wakanda in the throes of violent civil upheaval. King T'Challa struggles to preserve constitutional order as grassroots insurgencies challenge monarchical legitimacy.

title: Batman: Year One
description: The canonical origin story establishing Bruce Wayne's inaugural year as the Caped Crusader alongside Lieutenant James Gordon's battle against systemic police corruption in Gotham City. A masterpiece of gritty crime noir realism.

title: Batman: The Long Halloween
description: A mysterious serial killer dubbed Holiday murders mobsters associated with the Falcone crime family on major holidays. Batman, Jim Gordon, and District Attorney Harvey Dent forge a fragile pact that tragically births Two-Face.

title: Batman: The Dark Knight Returns
authors: Frank Miller; Klaus Janson; Lynn Varley
description: A landmark graphic novel depicting a fifty-five-year-old Bruce Wayne emerging from ten years of retirement into a dystopian, media-saturated Gotham. Frank Miller reinvented comic book storytelling with this gritty psychological tour de force.

title: Watchmen
description: The celebrated graphic novel deconstructing the superhero mythos amidst alternate 1985 Cold War nuclear tensions. Following the murder of the Comedian, vigilante Rorschach investigates an insidious conspiracy involving former masked colleagues.

title: All-Star Superman
description: Diagnosed with terminal cellular radiation poisoning after saving a solar expedition, the Man of Steel spends his remaining days completing legendary heroic tasks. A mythic, heartfelt celebration of Superman's enduring optimism.

title: The Sandman, Vol. 1: Preludes & Nocturnes
authors: Neil Gaiman; Sam Kieth; Mike Dringenberg
description: Imprisoned for seven decades by an amateur occultist, Morpheus, the King of Dreams, finally escapes into modern London. To reclaim his decayed kingdom of the Dreaming, he must recover his stolen tools: sand pouch, helm, and ruby.

title: The Sandman, Vol. 2: The Doll's House
authors: Neil Gaiman; Mike Dringenberg; Malcolm Jones III
description: Morpheus tracks down four rogue dreams escaped from his realm while young Rose Walker searches for her lost brother, unknowingly acting as a dream vortex capable of collapsing the boundaries between human minds.

title: Kingdom Come
description: Set in a near future overrun by reckless, violent second-generation metahumans, an aging Superman returns from self-imposed exile to restore classical justice. Illustrated with Alex Ross's rich photorealistic gouache paintings.

title: V for Vendetta
description: In a post-apocalyptic fascist Britain, a masked theatrical anarchist named V wages an asymmetric psychological insurgency against the totalitarian Norsefire regime, taking traumatized young Evey Hammond under his wing.

title: Superman: Red Son
authors: Mark Millar; Dave Johnson; Kilian Plunkett
description: An Elseworlds alternate history exploring what would have happened if Kal-El's Kryptonian rocket had landed on a collective farm in the 1950s Soviet Union instead of Kansas. Superman becomes the champion of socialism and state security.

title: Solo Leveling, Vol. 1
description: Sung Jinwoo, notorious as the "Weakest Hunter of All Mankind", faces certain demise inside a hidden double dungeon. Bestowed with a mysterious gaming quest system visible only to him, he begins an unprecedented solitary power progression.

title: Solo Leveling, Vol. 3
description: During a high-stakes job change quest, Jinwoo battles endless waves of spectral knights. Overcoming impossible odds, he unlocks the Shadow Monarch specialization, empowering him to extract defeated enemies as loyal shadow soldiers.

title: Lore Olympus: Volume One
description: A stylish modern webcomic retelling of the Taking of Persephone. Navigating Olympus gossip, complex family dynamics, and trauma, young spring goddess Persephone forms an unexpected connection with the brooding CEO of the Underworld, Hades.

title: The Remarried Empress, Vol. 1
description: Navier Ellie Trovi is the perfect empress of the Eastern Empire until Emperor Sovieshu brings a runaway slave mistress to court and demands divorce. Refusing victimhood, Navier boldly accepts the divorce on one condition: permission to remarry King Heinrey.
